+"""Paired CUDA scheduling microbenchmark; NOT a serving-performance benchmark.
+
+Compare production host methods from two source snapshots using the same
+weights/inputs. The fixture substitutes torch operators for the pooler, router
+and experts, so timings do not represent a loaded Muse Spark model or TP/EP.
+
+    git show BASE:python/sglang/srt/models/muse_spark.py > /tmp/muse_base.py
+    python test/manual/muse_spark/bench_norm_overlap.py \
+        --baseline-source /tmp/muse_base.py --tokens 1 16 128 --graph
+
+Run real serving benchmarks separately with identical checkpoint, server
+arguments, prompts and hardware on both revisions before claiming a speedup.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import statistics
+
+import torch
+from test_norm_overlap import Fixture, load_methods
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--baseline-source", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--tokens", type=int, nargs="+", default=[1, 16, 128])
+    parser.add_argument("--hidden", type=int, default=8192)
+    parser.add_argument("--expert-hidden", type=int, default=4096)
+    parser.add_argument("--experts", type=int, default=256)
+    parser.add_argument("--top-k", type=int, default=8)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument("--pairs", type=int, default=20)
+    parser.add_argument("--iterations", type=int, default=100)
+    parser.add_argument("--graph", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        parser.error("CUDA is required; no CPU timing substitute")
+    if min(args.tokens + [args.pairs, args.iterations]) <= 0:
+        parser.error("tokens, pairs and iterations must be positive")
+    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
+    f = Fixture(
+        "cuda",
+        hidden=args.hidden,
+        expert_hidden=args.expert_hidden,
+        num_experts=args.experts,
+        top_k=args.top_k,
+    )
+    f.weight = f.weight.bfloat16()
+    f.model.pre_expert_proj.weight = f.weight
+    f.model.router_in_fp32 = True
+    baseline = load_methods(dict(f.scope), args.baseline_source)["_forward_experts"]
+    candidate = f.scope["_forward_experts"]
+    report = dict(
+        config=vars(args),
+        gpu=torch.cuda.get_device_name(),
+        torch=torch.__version__,
+        cuda=torch.version.cuda,
+        scope="weight-free scheduling surrogate, warm weights, no TP/EP",
+        rows=[],
+    )
+    for tokens in args.tokens:
+        x = torch.randn(tokens, args.hidden, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        methods = [baseline, candidate]
+        runs = [lambda method=m: method(f.model, x) for m in methods]
+        for _ in range(10):
+            for run in runs:
+                torch.testing.assert_close(run(), f.reference(x))
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        graphs, outputs = [], []
+        if args.graph:
+            for run in runs:
+                graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+                with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+                    output = run()
+                graphs.append(graph)
+                outputs.append(output)
+            runs = [g.replay for g in graphs]
+            # Correctness is checked after changing captured input data too.
+            for _ in range(3):
+                x.normal_()
+                for run, output in zip(runs, outputs):
+                    run()
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(output, f.reference(x))
+        raw = []
+        for pair in range(args.pairs):
+            measurements = [None, None]
+            for idx in [0, 1] if pair % 2 == 0 else [1, 0]:
+                start, end = (
+                    torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True),
+                    torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True),
+                )
+                start.record()
+                for _ in range(args.iterations):
+                    runs[idx]()
+                end.record()
+                end.synchronize()
+                measurements[idx] = start.elapsed_time(end) * 1000 / args.iterations
+                f.events.clear()
+            raw.append(measurements)
+        report["rows"].append(
+            dict(
+                tokens=tokens,
+                baseline_candidate_us=raw,
+                median_baseline_us=statistics.median(p[0] for p in raw),
+                median_candidate_us=statistics.median(p[1] for p in raw),
+            )
+        )
+    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Real BF16 backend A/B; base host method and PR method share weights/inputs.
+
+Not a serving benchmark. Imports the registered real-component fixture.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import ast
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import statistics
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.models import muse_spark
+
+
+def main():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    p.add_argument("--baseline-source", required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--backend", choices=["triton", "trtllm"], required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--tokens", type=int, nargs="+", default=[1, 16, 128, 129])
+    p.add_argument("--hidden", type=int, default=8192)
+    p.add_argument("--expert-hidden", type=int, default=4096)
+    p.add_argument("--intermediate", type=int, default=4096)
+    p.add_argument("--experts", type=int, default=256)
+    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    p.add_argument("--pairs", type=int, default=20)
+    p.add_argument("--iterations", type=int, default=50)
+    p.add_argument("--graph", action="store_true")
+    args = p.parse_args()
+    fixture_path = (
+        Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+        / "registered/kernels/ops/moe/test_muse_spark_norm_overlap.py"
+    )
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("real_fixture", fixture_path)
+    fixture = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(fixture)
+    tree = ast.parse(Path(args.baseline_source).read_text())
+    cls = next(
+        n
+        for n in tree.body
+        if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "MuseSpark1xMoE"
+    )
+    method = next(
+        n
+        for n in cls.body
+        if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "_forward_experts"
+    )
+    namespace = dict(vars(muse_spark))
+    exec(
+        compile(
+            ast.Module(
+                body=[*ast.parse("from __future__ import annotations").body, method],
+                type_ignores=[],
+            ),
+            args.baseline_source,
+            "exec",
+        ),
+        namespace,
+    )
+    baseline = namespace["_forward_experts"]
+    report = {
+        "config": vars(args),
+        "gpu": torch.cuda.get_device_name(),
+        "torch": torch.__version__,
+        "rows": [],
+    }
+    with torch.inference_mode(), fixture.single_rank():
+        torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
+        layer = fixture.make_moe(
+            args.backend,
+            hidden=args.hidden,
+            expert_hidden=args.expert_hidden,
+            intermediate=args.intermediate,
+            experts=args.experts,
+        )
+        for tokens in args.tokens:
+            x = torch.randn(tokens, args.hidden, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+            runs = [lambda: baseline(layer, x), lambda: layer._forward_experts(x)]
+            for _ in range(5):
+                a, b = [run() for run in runs]
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            torch.testing.assert_close(a, b, rtol=0, atol=0)
+            graphs, outputs = [], []
+            if args.graph:
+                for run in runs:
+                    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+                    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+                        output = run()
+                    graphs.append(graph)
+                    outputs.append(output)
+                for _ in range(5):
+                    x.normal_()
+                    expected = fixture.serialized(layer, x)
+                    for graph in graphs:
+                        graph.replay()
+                    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                    for out in outputs:
+                        torch.testing.assert_close(out, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+                runs = [graph.replay for graph in graphs]
+            raw = []
+            for pair in range(args.pairs):
+                measurements = [None, None]
+                for idx in [0, 1] if pair % 2 == 0 else [1, 0]:
+                    start, end = (
+                        torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True),
+                        torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True),
+                    )
+                    start.record()
+                    for _ in range(args.iterations):
+                        runs[idx]()
+                    end.record()
+                    end.synchronize()
+                    measurements[idx] = start.elapsed_time(end) * 1000 / args.iterations
+                raw.append(measurements)
+            report["rows"].append(
+                {
+                    "tokens": tokens,
+                    "baseline_candidate_us": raw,
+                    "median_baseline_us": statistics.median(x[0] for x in raw),
+                    "median_candidate_us": statistics.median(x[1] for x in raw),
+                }
+            )
+            print(json.dumps(report), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Weight-free Muse Spark host scheduling and CUDA graph regression tests.
+
+Run with only PyTorch installed:
+    python test/manual/muse_spark/test_norm_overlap.py -v
+
+The production host methods are extracted without importing model/kernel
+backends. Small torch operators replace the pooler, router and experts: this
+checks scheduling, not FlashInfer kernels, distributed execution or accuracy
+of a loaded model. CUDA tests skip on CPU-only machines.
+"""
+
+import ast
+import contextlib
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+SOURCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "python/sglang/srt/models/muse_spark.py"
+
+
+def load_methods(scope, source=SOURCE):
+    tree = ast.parse(Path(source).read_text())
+    cls = next(
+        n
+        for n in tree.body
+        if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "MuseSpark1xMoE"
+    )
+    methods = [
+        n
+        for n in cls.body
+        if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)
+        and n.name in ("_forward_experts", "_forward_sp_experts")
+    ]
+    module = ast.Module(
+        body=[*ast.parse("from __future__ import annotations").body, *methods],
+        type_ignores=[],
+    )
+    exec(compile(module, str(source), "exec"), scope)
+    return scope
+
+
+class Fixture:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        device="cpu",
+        *,
+        sp=False,
+        nvfp4=False,
+        projection=True,
+        norm=True,
+        split=False,
+        hidden=32,
+        expert_hidden=32,
+        num_experts=8,
+        top_k=2,
+        source=SOURCE,
+    ):
+        self.events = []
+        self.sp = sp
+        self.device = device
+        self.side = torch.cuda.Stream() if device == "cuda" else None
+        self.weight = torch.randn(expert_hidden, hidden, device=device)
+        self.router_weight = torch.randn(num_experts, hidden, device=device)
+        self.forward = SimpleNamespace(sp_active=sp)
+        self.scope = load_methods(
+            dict(
+                torch=torch,
+                contextlib=contextlib,
+                _is_cpu=device == "cpu",
+                get_forward=lambda: self.forward,
+                _use_split_bf16_router=lambda _: split,
+                bf16_gemm_dispatch=lambda x, w, _: self.project(x),
+                get_global_experts_capturer=lambda: None,
+            ),
+            source,
+        )
+        experts = self.Experts(self)
+        self.model = SimpleNamespace(
+            router_in_fp32=split,
+            gate=self.Gate(self),
+            nvfp4_checkpoint=nvfp4,
+            experts=experts,
+            tp_size=1,
+            top_k=top_k,
+            expert_hidden_size=expert_hidden,
+            pre_expert_proj=SimpleNamespace(weight=self.weight) if projection else None,
+            pre_expert_norm=self.norm if norm else None,
+            _side_stream=lambda: self.side,
+            _routing_op=lambda: self.route,
+        )
+        if device == "cpu" and projection:
+            self.model.pre_expert_proj = lambda x: (self.project(x), None)
+        self.model._forward_sp_experts = self.sp_experts
+
+    def project(self, x):
+        self.events.append("project")
+        return F.linear(x, self.weight)
+
+    def norm(self, x):
+        self.events.append("norm")
+        return F.rms_norm(x, (x.shape[-1],))
+
+    class Gate:
+        def __init__(self, fixture):
+            self.fixture = fixture
+            self.weight = fixture.router_weight
+
+        def __call__(self, x):
+            self.fixture.events.append("gate")
+            return F.linear(x.float(), self.weight)
+
+        def forward_split2(self, x):
+            return self(x)
+
+    def route(self, _, logits, k, renormalize, want_packed):
+        self.events.append("route")
+        scores, ids = torch.topk(torch.sigmoid(logits), k)
+        scores = scores / scores.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+        return scores, ids, ids.clone()
+
+    class Experts:
+        post_expert_norm = None
+        use_marlin = False
+
+        def __init__(self, fixture):
+            self.fixture = fixture
+
+        def prepare_input(self, x, norm):
+            self.fixture.events.append("prepare")
+            return norm(x) if norm else x
+
+        def __call__(
+            self,
+            x,
+            scores,
+            ids,
+            post_norm,
+            *,
+            pre_expert_norm=None,
+            prepared_input=None,
+            **kwargs,
+        ):
+            self.fixture.events.append("experts")
+            if prepared_input is not None:
+                x = prepared_input
+            elif pre_expert_norm is not None:
+                x = pre_expert_norm(x)
+            # Depend on every routing result as well as the normalized input.
+            return x * ((ids.float() + 1) * scores).sum(-1, keepdim=True)
+
+    def sp_experts(self, x, scores, ids, logits):
+        self.events.append("sp")
+        if self.model.pre_expert_norm:
+            x = self.model.pre_expert_norm(x)
+        return self.model.experts(x, scores, ids, None)
+
+    def run(self, x, router_input=None):
+        return self.scope["_forward_experts"](self.model, x, router_input)
+
+    def reference(self, x, router_input=None):
+        # Serial mathematical oracle, independent of the host scheduling method.
+        expert_input = (
+            F.linear(x, self.weight) if self.model.pre_expert_proj is not None else x
+        )
+        if self.model.pre_expert_norm:
+            expert_input = F.rms_norm(expert_input, (expert_input.shape[-1],))
+        logits = F.linear(
+            x.float() if router_input is None else router_input, self.router_weight
+        )
+        scores, ids = torch.topk(torch.sigmoid(logits), self.model.top_k)
+        scores /= scores.sum(-1, keepdim=True)
+        return expert_input * ((ids.float() + 1) * scores).sum(-1, keepdim=True)
+
+
+class Stream:
+    def __init__(self, name, events):
+        self.name, self.events = name, events
+
+    def wait_stream(self, other):
+        self.events.append(f"{self.name} waits {other.name}")
+
+
+class TestHostSchedule(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_fork_norm_join_and_lifetime(self):
+        for sp in (False, True):
+            for nvfp4 in (False, True):
+                for capture in (False, True):
+                    with self.subTest(sp=sp, nvfp4=nvfp4, capture=capture):
+                        f = Fixture(sp=sp, nvfp4=nvfp4, projection=False)
+                        f.scope["_is_cpu"] = False
+                        main, side = Stream("main", f.events), Stream("side", f.events)
+                        f.side = side
+                        with (
+                            patch.object(torch.cuda, "is_available", return_value=True),
+                            patch.object(
+                                torch.cuda, "current_stream", return_value=main
+                            ),
+                            patch.object(
+                                torch.cuda,
+                                "stream",
+                                side_effect=lambda _: contextlib.nullcontext(),
+                            ),
+                            patch.object(
+                                torch.cuda,
+                                "is_current_stream_capturing",
+                                return_value=capture,
+                            ),
+                            patch.object(
+                                torch.Tensor,
+                                "record_stream",
+                                side_effect=lambda _: f.events.append("record"),
+                            ),
+                        ):
+                            x = torch.randn(4, 32)
+                            torch.testing.assert_close(f.run(x), f.reference(x))
+                        self.assertEqual(f.events.count("norm"), 1)
+                        self.assertLess(
+                            f.events.index("side waits main"), f.events.index("gate")
+                        )
+                        self.assertLess(
+                            f.events.index("route"), f.events.index("main waits side")
+                        )
+                        self.assertLess(
+                            f.events.index("main waits side"), f.events.index("experts")
+                        )
+                        if not sp:
+                            self.assertLess(
+                                f.events.index("norm"),
+                                f.events.index("main waits side"),
+                            )
+                        else:
+                            self.assertLess(
+                                f.events.index("main waits side"),
+                                f.events.index("norm"),
+                            )
+                        self.assertEqual(f.events.count("record"), 0 if capture else 3)
+
+    def test_int4_selection_is_cpu_only(self):
+        # Load the production selection predicates without GPU dependencies.
+        tree = ast.parse(SOURCE.read_text())
+        functions = [
+            n
+            for n in tree.body
+            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)
+            and n.name in ("_quantization_name", "_uses_gptq_int4_experts")
+        ]
+        scope = {}
+        exec(
+            compile(
+                ast.Module(
+                    body=[
+                        *ast.parse("from __future__ import annotations").body,
+                        *functions,
+                    ],
+                    type_ignores=[],
+                ),
+                str(SOURCE),
+                "exec",
+            ),
+            scope,
+        )
+        configs = [
+            SimpleNamespace(get_name=lambda: "gptq"),
+            SimpleNamespace(get_name=lambda: "auto-round", packing_format="auto_gptq"),
+            SimpleNamespace(get_name=lambda: "auto-round", backend="gptq"),
+        ]
+        for cpu in (False, True):
+            scope["_is_cpu"] = cpu
+            for config in configs:
+                self.assertEqual(scope["_uses_gptq_int4_experts"](config), cpu)
+            self.assertFalse(scope["_uses_gptq_int4_experts"](None))
+        # The INT4 caller uses the non-NVFP4 CPU path. Its order stays serial:
+        # projection -> gate -> routing -> norm -> experts, with no CUDA stream.
+        f = Fixture(device="cpu", nvfp4=False, projection=True)
+        f.run(torch.randn(3, 32))
+        self.assertEqual(f.events, ["project", "gate", "route", "norm", "experts"])
+
+    def test_cpu_fallback_and_empty(self):
+        for projection in (False, True):
+            for norm in (False, True):
+                for tokens in (0, 1, 129):
+                    with self.subTest(projection=projection, norm=norm, tokens=tokens):
+                        f = Fixture(projection=projection, norm=norm)
+                        x = torch.randn(tokens, 32)
+                        torch.testing.assert_close(f.run(x), f.reference(x))
+                        if tokens == 0:
+                            self.assertEqual(f.events, [])
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "requires CUDA")
+class TestCudaSchedule(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_eager_and_graph_replay(self):
+        for projection in (False, True):
+            for split in (False, True):
+                for tokens in (1, 16, 129):
+                    with self.subTest(
+                        projection=projection, split=split, tokens=tokens
+                    ):
+                        f = Fixture("cuda", projection=projection, split=split)
+                        x = torch.randn(
+                            tokens,
+                            32,
+                            device="cuda",
+                            dtype=torch.bfloat16 if split else torch.float32,
+                        )
+                        # Projection uses float32 for this weight-free scheduling fixture.
+                        if split:
+                            f.weight = f.weight.bfloat16()
+                            if projection:
+                                f.model.pre_expert_proj.weight = f.weight
+                        for _ in range(3):
+                            torch.testing.assert_close(f.run(x), f.reference(x))
+                        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+                        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+                            output = f.run(x)
+                        for _ in range(5):
+                            x.normal_()  # Replays must use new routing and norm inputs.
+                            graph.replay()
+                            torch.testing.assert_close(output, f.reference(x))
+
+    def test_allocator_churn_on_two_call_streams(self):
+        fixtures = [Fixture("cuda"), Fixture("cuda")]
+        streams = [torch.cuda.Stream(), torch.cuda.Stream()]
+        results = []
+        for _ in range(20):
+            for f, stream in zip(fixtures, streams):
+                stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+                with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+                    x = torch.randn(16, 32, device="cuda")
+                    results.append((f.run(x), f.reference(x)))
+                    # Drop router intermediates, then encourage allocator reuse.
+                    torch.empty((16, 32), device="cuda").fill_(float("nan"))
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        for output, expected in results:
+            torch.testing.assert_close(output, expected)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""Real Muse Spark BF16 components: overlap versus a serialized execution.
+
+Small random weights, TP=EP=1; no checkpoint or serving-accuracy claim.
+Both Triton and (on SM10x) TRT-LLM execute their actual expert kernels.
+"""
+
+import contextlib
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.configs.muse_spark import MuseSparkTextConfig
+from sglang.srt.layers.muse_spark import muse_spark_bf16_moe
+from sglang.srt.models import muse_spark
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context, get_forward, get_parallel
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=120, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+
+
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def single_rank():
+    with (
+        get_context().override_server_args(model_path="dummy"),
+        get_parallel().override(
+            tp_size=1,
+            tp_rank=0,
+            attn_tp_size=1,
+            attn_tp_rank=0,
+            attn_dp_size=1,
+            attn_cp_size=1,
+            moe_ep_size=1,
+            moe_ep_rank=0,
+            moe_tp_size=1,
+            moe_dp_size=1,
+        ),
+        get_forward().scoped(sp_active=False),
+    ):
+        yield
+
+
+def make_moe(
+    backend,
+    projection=True,
+    hidden=1024,
+    expert_hidden=512,
+    intermediate=512,
+    experts=16,
+    top_k=8,
+):
+    config = MuseSparkTextConfig(
+        hidden_size=hidden if projection else expert_hidden,
+        moe_hidden_size=expert_hidden,
+        moe_intermediate_size=intermediate,
+        num_local_experts=experts,
+        num_experts_per_tok=top_k,
+    )
+    # Construct the production class, including its configured weighted norms.
+    with torch.device("cuda"):
+        layer = muse_spark.MuseSpark1xMoE(config, 0, False, "test")
+    layer.bfloat16()
+    layer.gate.float()  # Production router weights and correction bias are FP32.
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for name, param in layer.named_parameters():
+            param.normal_(0, 0.05 if "norm" in name else param.shape[-1] ** -0.5)
+        layer.gate.e_score_correction_bias.uniform_(-0.05, 0.05)
+        for norm in (layer.pre_expert_norm, layer.experts.post_expert_norm):
+            norm.precompute_effective_weight()
+    if backend == "triton":
+        with patch.object(
+            muse_spark_bf16_moe, "_trtllm_bf16_moe_supported", return_value=False
+        ):
+            layer.experts.prepare_trtllm_weights(layer.experts.post_expert_norm)
+        assert layer.experts.use_triton and not layer.experts.use_trtllm
+    else:
+        layer.experts.prepare_trtllm_weights(layer.experts.post_expert_norm)
+        assert layer.experts.use_trtllm and not layer.experts.use_triton
+    return layer
+
+
+def serialized(layer, x):
+    """Same production operators, all on the caller stream (no overlap)."""
+    split = (
+        layer.router_in_fp32
+        and muse_spark._use_split_bf16_router(x.shape[0])
+        and layer.gate.weight.dtype == torch.float32
+        and x.dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16)
+    )
+    projected = (
+        x
+        if layer.pre_expert_proj is None
+        else muse_spark.bf16_gemm_dispatch(x, layer.pre_expert_proj.weight, None)
+    )
+    logits = layer.gate.forward_split2(x) if split else layer.gate(x.float())
+    scores, ids, packed = layer._routing_op()(
+        None, logits, layer.top_k, True, want_packed=True
+    )
+    if layer.pre_expert_norm is not None:
+        projected = layer.pre_expert_norm(projected)
+    return layer.experts(
+        projected, scores, ids, layer.experts.post_expert_norm, packed_topk_ids=packed
+    )
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "CUDA required")
+class TestMuseSparkNormOverlap(CustomTestCase):
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def _check_backend(self, backend):
+        with single_rank():
+            for projection in (False, True):
+                torch.manual_seed(42)
+                layer = make_moe(backend, projection)
+                for tokens in (1, 16, 128, 129):
+                    with self.subTest(
+                        backend=backend, projection=projection, tokens=tokens
+                    ):
+                        x = torch.randn(
+                            tokens,
+                            layer.hidden_size,
+                            device="cuda",
+                            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                        )
+                        for _ in range(3):
+                            expected = serialized(layer, x)
+                            actual = layer._forward_experts(x)
+                        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+                        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+                        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+                            captured = layer._forward_experts(x)
+                        for _ in range(5):
+                            x.normal_()
+                            expected = serialized(layer, x)
+                            graph.replay()
+                            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                                captured, expected, rtol=0, atol=0
+                            )
+
+    def test_triton(self):
+        self._check_backend("triton")
+
+    @unittest.skipUnless(
+        torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] == 10,
+        "TRT-LLM BF16 requires SM10x",
+    )
+    def test_trtllm(self):
+        self._check_backend("trtllm")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
